text:
You need a full-function e-commerce Shopify store with strong product presentation, essential store functionality, payments, and conversion-focused pages that can sell fashion, clothing, electronics, and other products.

I’m Tobias Reyne, and I build full-stack web experiences with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. For a store like this, I’d focus on the parts that matter most: clean templates, intuitive menus, strong product/category structure, smooth payment flow, and clear notification or confirmation touchpoints that make the buying process feel reliable and polished.

One project I built was a white-label booking platform for fitness studios using Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma, and Stripe. Each studio had its own subdomain, timetable, and memberships. The result was 64 studios onboarded in 6 months and a 71% checkout conversion rate, which shows I know how to build user flows that actually convert.

I also built a monthly statement PDF generator for Alder Property Group using Node.js, BullMQ, Redis, Puppeteer, and AWS S3. It rendered owner statements overnight and stored them in S3 instead of generating them on demand. That setup handled 12k statements a month and took request timeouts from daily to none. I bring that same focus on reliability and performance to e-commerce builds, especially where checkout and customer notifications need to work consistently.

For your Shopify store, I’d aim to deliver a structure that feels professional from the first click: strong homepage sections, product collection layouts, clean navigation, payment-ready product pages, and essential conversion elements that support sales across multiple product categories. I’m comfortable working full stack and translating business goals into a store that’s both easy to browse and ready to sell.

If you want, I can help you shape the store structure, customer journey, and functionality so it’s ready for launch and built with conversion in mind.
